title: Audit
fit: When you need to know what to fix first.
text: A focused review of the evidence, the experience and the constraints. We define the questions, inspect agreed systems and deliver a prioritized set of recommendations.
owner_fields: [Owner to confirm: audit scope, turnaround, fee and presentation format.]

title: Project
fit: When there is a defined outcome to deliver.
text: A bounded engagement for a website, product release, campaign setup or measurement implementation. Scope, dependencies and acceptance criteria are agreed before delivery.
owner_fields: [Owner to confirm: milestone/payment structure, change control and support period.]

title: Retainer
fit: When improvement needs a consistent rhythm.
text: A rolling backlog of priorities across acquisition, content, analytics or optimization. Capacity and review cadence are agreed so the work stays connected to business needs.
owner_fields: [Owner to confirm: capacity, term, reporting cadence and cancellation terms.]

title: Embedded team
fit: When your team needs additional delivery capacity.
text: Work alongside internal product, marketing or engineering teams with clear ownership. Agree decision rights, access and delivery responsibilities before work begins.
owner_fields: [Owner to confirm: roles, allocation, availability and escalation contacts.]
